description: Read one local document (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, ODT/ODS/ODP, CSV, PNG/JPG/TIFF/WebP, saved web pages HTML/MHTML, EPUB, emails EML/MSG, RSS/Atom feeds) or audio/video file (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, AIFF, MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, M4V) as token-lean Markdown. Audio and video: this transcribes locally with an on-device speech model (nothing is uploaded), the first run of a long recording takes a while (the result is cached by content), video also lists new on-screen text, and it needs ffmpeg for formats other than WAV and a one-time install (see distill_capabilities; fails with asr_unavailable until `distill-llm asr install` is run). For a live web page use distill_url. Read-only: never modifies or uploads the file. Use distill_files for several files at once and distill_outline first for long documents, then pass `section` or `offset`/`limit`. Output is capped at about 10000 tokens per call; follow `nextOffset`. Fails with password_protected, needs_libreoffice (legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt and OpenDocument), forbidden (outside allowed roots), too_large (over 100 MB for documents, 2 GB for audio and video), asr_unavailable, ffmpeg_missing, no_audio or parse_failed. Tables and scans are only as faithful as the parser. Pages listed in visualPages contain charts or images that are not in the text; if the question depends on them, view the original page with distill_page_image. visualPages[].page is the physical page number (1-based position in the PDF); label is the printed page label, only present when it differs.

boosters.description: Lossless cleanups to apply, default all: dedupe (repeated headers and footers), media (shorter image paths and link URLs), tables (removes padding), ws (collapses whitespace). Pass a subset to keep, for example, link URLs

frames.description: Video only. ocr (default) adds the on-screen text that appears, once each, as > [slide mm:ss] blocks between the speech; none skips it and is faster

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read from offset (or from line 1); paging stays inside this window

lingua.description: Optional LLMLingua-2 compression, lossy: it removes words. Only works when installed (see distill_capabilities); avoid it for contracts and other exact text

offset.description: Line to start from (1-based), for documents too large to return at once; use the nextOffset from the previous call or a line from distill_outline

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the server's working directory

section.description: Title of a section from distill_outline (case-insensitive; exact match first, then substring). Reads just that section; cannot be combined with offset

timestamps.description: Audio and video only. Timestamps in the transcript: coarse (default, a [mm:ss] about once a minute), none (fewest tokens) or segment (one per spoken segment, to quote precise moments)

name: distill_file
title: Read a document as Markdown
